title: Microencapsulation of red palm oil with soy protein concentrate–carrageenan conjugates for compound dark chocolate applications
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,2337-2351
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00278H, Paper

Haida Setyani, Arima Diah Setiowati, Sri Rahayoe, Chusnul Hidayat, Arifin Dwi Saputro
Red palm oil was microencapsulated using soy protein–carrageenan, improving encapsulation efficiency and enabling its incorporation into chocolate with minimal sensory impact.
